# Sound

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Audio` · class

```csharp
public sealed class Sound : IContent
```

Types: [`IContent`](IContent.md)

A decoded sound cue. Sounds are produced by `Content.LoadAsync<Sound>(contentKey)`. To play a sound, create one or more reusable [`SoundVoice`](SoundVoice.md) objects via [`AudioService.CreateVoice`](AudioService.md#createvoice); each voice owns pre-allocated platform resources and plays this sound's data with no further managed-side allocation.

## Remarks

`Sound` is the framework's atomic, single-buffer audio resource — the audio analogue of [`Graphics.Texture`](Texture.md). The framework deliberately has no notion of a sub-range within a sound; higher-level concepts such as sound banks express named cues by pairing a sound with an offset and duration at voice-creation time.

`Sound` is [`IContent`](IContent.md): its decoded audio is released by `Content.UnloadAsync`. Callers do not see a public `Dispose` method and must not attempt to dispose a sound directly; the content service owns that lifecycle.
